useMultiThread.description: The **Enable multiple threads** setting. `true`: The Space is a Multi-threaded Space. `false`: The setting will not be updated, as a Multi-Threaded Space can not be reverted to a Single-threaded Space.

showMemberList.description: The display status for the **People** widget. `true`: The **People** widget is displayed. `false`: The **People** widget is not displayed.

showRelatedLinkList.description: The display status for the **Related Apps & Spaces** widget. `true`: The **Related Apps & Spaces** widget is displayed. `false`: The **Related Apps & Spaces** widget is not displayed.

isPrivate.description: The **Private** settings of the Space. `true`: The Space is private. `false`: The Space is not private.

showAnnouncement.description: The display status for the **Announcement** widget. `true`: The **Announcement** widget is displayed. `false`: The **Announcement** widget is not displayed.

showThreadList.description: The display status for the **Threads** widget. `true`: The **Threads** widget is displayed. `false`: The **Threads** widget is not displayed.

showAppList.description: The display status for the **Apps** widget. `true`: The **Apps** widget is displayed. `false`: The **Apps** widget is not displayed.
